propositions: Plan-review gate needs two new blocking deterministic checks (P10 verification-presence and P11 ac-vagueness) to reduce false positives and false negatives on leaf plan validation

P10 verification-presence must pass plans with a Testing/Verification section, code-span-containing AC items, or AC items matching a verification vocabulary (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked:, verif*, exit code)

P11 ac-vagueness must apply fixed lexicon with proper word boundaries (eliminating spurious `clean` matches on words like cleanly) and code-span exemption logic only to AC item lines, with etc. exempt when within 30 characters after a span
P6 ac-quality remains advisory; the fixed lexicon is synchronized between P6 and P11 blocking surface
Unit test fixture lines from backtests (clean, etc.) must not fire on P11 while three positive vague cases must fire
Documentation in docs/plan-review-gate.md must describe P10 and P11 deterministic floor checks
